name: Is it better to do a full repaint or just touch up problem areas?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to do a full repaint or just touch up problem areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a full repaint and touch-ups depends on the overall condition of your paint. Touch-ups are ideal for isolated imperfections like minor scuffs, dings, or small stains that don't cover large sections. If the entire room's paint is faded, discolored, or has widespread damage, a full repaint will likely yield a more uniform and refreshed result. A full repaint ensures consistent color and finish throughout. We can help assess your specific situation to recommend the most cost-effective and aesthetically pleasing solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Touch-ups are best for isolated, minor imperfections. A full repaint is better for widespread fading, discoloration, or damage across an entire room.
